intro-1.text: Most satisfaction surveys lose people at the click-through: open a link, wait for a page, then fill out a form.

intro-2.text: With CLICK-zenn, the rating buttons sit right in the email, so a single click is the entire survey.

good-1.text: Start with a button for happy customers. In CLICK-zenn, click Create new button, and name it see-sat Good.

good-2.text: Type its label right on the button: Great. Then give it a friendly green.

good-3.text: Now the actions. Click Add button action, choose Add Ticket Tag, and enter see-sat good.

good-4.text: Add a second action, Update Ticket Field, to set a see-sat rating custom field to good. Then click Create.

bad-1.text: Then build its partner, Not so good. It adds the tag see-sat bad, and sets see-sat rating to bad.

bad-2.text: It also sets the ticket status back to Open, so an unhappy customer gets attention straight away. Click Create.

scales-1.text: That's the simple version: two buttons, good or bad.

scales-2.text: Want more detail? Build five buttons instead, from 1, Very bad, to 5, Great, each with its own rating and tag.

email-1.text: Put the buttons in the email that goes out when a ticket is solved. That can be a trigger email, or part of your solve macro.

email-2.text: Write a short question, then paste the two snippets side by side.

email-3.text: Save the trigger, and your survey is live.

result-1.text: Your customer gets one simple question, and two buttons.

result-2.text: One click on Great, and they land on your branded thank-you page. That's the whole survey.

result-3.text: Back in Zendesk, the rating is already on the ticket, as a tag and a custom field, ready to report on in Zendesk Explore.

loop-1.text: Here's where it gets powerful. Because the rating is a tag, your Zendesk triggers can act on it instantly.

loop-2.text: When see-sat bad is added, a trigger can reopen the ticket, raise the priority to High, alert a team lead, and tell the customer a senior agent is on it.

loop-3.text: A poor rating stops being a number in a dashboard, and becomes a recovery that starts within seconds.

outro-1.text: Compared with Zendesk's built-in survey, you choose the wording, the look, the scale, and where it appears.

outro-2.text: Use it in any trigger, macro, or reply, even where native satisfaction surveys aren't available.

outro-3.text: Find CLICK-zenn on the Zendesk Marketplace, and make your next survey a single click.
